scientific_integrity: All claims follow from the written analytical proof; exhaustive finite checks supplement but cannot certify asymptotic or universal quantifiers. Publication priority may require independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed numbers m>k>=2 of candidates/committee seats, 0<q<1, independent identically distributed voter-candidate approvals. Coupling is asymptotically informative away from q endpoints; no claims for growing m, endogenous ballots, arbitrary dependence, individual representation, or higher-cohesion EJR.
title: A sharp Bernoulli transition and counting law for strong committee representation
